subject: an open supply satchel with three distinct items protruding from the opening, a stoppered potion bottle, a rolled scroll and a hanging charm. Three distinguishable outlines and a soft bag silhouette, unlike L5's single die in a rigid box. Keep the potion neutral in color so it does not name a specific item. Give each category a distinct silhouette at 96 pixels, including beside a boss emblem. Use no typography, numbers, actual card artwork, labels, price, card frame or interface overlays. Any die is an opaque ivory die with dark ink pips, no red or blue pips and no gold or glass faces. The item is a reward; gold is reserved for the specified prize accent, not a die face or a universal rarity color. Item-specific restrictions: no red or blue potion; no coins; no letters or runes on the scroll or charm.

extraReferences.role: SUBJECT REFERENCE ONLY. Keep the same objects, count, functional symbols and arrangement. Neutral dice must have dark pips, and neutral faces stay opaque. Use only reference 1 for style, material, shading and colour treatment.
